veranderings.rede: 'n Naam van sy eie' follows English 'a name of his own'; ''n eie naam' is the natural Afrikaans form, shorter and same meaning.

vlae.teks: 'n Reg is nog so iets wat jy kry sonder om dit te verdien. Party regte kry jy omdat jy 'n mens is
vlae.rede: Rights lesson: the study text states as fact that you GET a right ('wat jy kry', 'kry jy'), while the glossary entry says 'wat jy moet kry' and the Grondwet block says some children do not get food or a home. Not changed because it touches meaning and the parallel with the name sentence; a person or the writer should decide whether 'kry' should be 'moet kry' here.

vlae.teks: Die wet vra dat 'n kind se geboorte gewoonlik binne 30 dae by die regering geregistreer word.
vlae.rede: Read literally, the law asks that a birth 'usually' be registered within 30 days, which is odd logic; the softening seems meant for what happens in practice. 'gewoonlik' is protected, so not changed; the writer may want to check what the qualifier attaches to.
